notes.title: Public Beta Branch is Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/273e24f24b38877377e87af3b113269738c5b0ad.png[/img]

[h3][i]Reporting in, Agents. [/i][/h3]

[b]Version 360 is now available in the main branch, marking our 1st Early Access update.[/b]
After being in the public beta for a couple of weeks, the Save Game and Quick Join Systems are now available for all players to use.




[h3]Early Access Build Ver. 360 Patch Notes[/h3]
Here are the changes implemented in this beta build:

[b]IMPROVEMENTS & NEW FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a Quick Join feature to streamline matchmaking and let players jump into sessions faster.
[*] Implemented a save/load function to let players better manage their progress.
[*] The mission map can now be zoomed and freely dragged, allowing for smoother navigation and planning.
[*] Trailer subtitles can now be changed according to the language selected in the Options menu.
[*] Rebalanced defense map waves: enemy HP now scales every 3 waves, providing a more consistent difficulty curve.
[*] Enabled Steam Cloud support so player progress can now be backed up and synced automatically.[/list]
[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where solving the insignia puzzle could unexpectedly send players back to the main menu when using game controllers.
[*] Adjusted balance for endless waves after completing mission objectives to improve pacing and challenge.
[*] Fixed an issue where canceling a grenade throw would cause the animation to become stuck when viewed from other players’ perspectives.
[*] Resolved incorrect rendering of Thai vowels.
[*] Corrected several localization problems, including text size inconsistencies and mismatched fonts across different languages.
[*] Fixed police station computer clue date format (DD-MM-YY) to match puzzle logic.
[*] Corrected attack behavior for the Hairmaiden and Hollow Mother, making their combat patterns function as intended.
[*] Fixed a bug where the key obtained from the antique box could clip through walls and become inaccessible.
[*] Fixed an issue where clicking Reconnect sometimes produced a "Room Not Found" error.[/list]

[h3]Next future updates[/h3]
Now that the Save System and Quick Join features are implemented in Early Access, we’re on track to develop future updates. Below, you’ll find some “found footage” from the B.R.I.M. Support Division—offering a glimpse of what’s coming next. Stay tuned!

[b]Check out this found footage![/b]

Unload Ammo 

Item Dismantle

Hollow Baby - New Undead Anomaly! 

Roguelite Map Route - Branching Path

The Roguelike Branching Path update focuses on the versatility of players as they make choices in each run. Later, you will have a variety of missions and dynamic modifiers, allowing you to approach your investigation in different ways.

[h3]We want to hear your feedback![/h3]
If you encounter any issues or bugs, you can reach out to us on Steam discussions, social media, or the Toge Productions Discord community. 

[b]We also have an email and a feedback form where you can directly send your feedback to us. [/b]
Email: wmo@togeproductions.com 
Feedback form: [url=https://forms.gle/9vA9KNNTZpKPYzK38]Whisper Mountain Outbreak Feedback Form[/url]

We look forward to your participation! We are grateful for your kind support after the release of Early Access, and we look forward to seeing you soon in the next announcement. 

[h3]On another news...[/h3]
[b][i]Whisper Mountain Outbreak has officially surpassed 50,000 copies sold![/i][/b]
Just one month after the Early Access launch, we even reached a greater milestone! It’s all thanks to you, all of our Agents eager to investigate in the field. Thank you!

The B.R.I.M. Support Division always monitors and aids our agents amid investigations. You can join our community to connect with other agents and provide more direct suggestions and feedback to us.

notes.title: We Hear You! Save System (and More) Coming Soon
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/3655ec0fa4d54b77c116d810a91d002dc1f92fd3.png[/img]

[h3][i]Reporting in, Agents.[/i][/h3]

[h3]Thank you for your support![/h3]
Whisper Mountain Outbreak has officially launched as Early Access, and we are incredibly thankful for your enthusiasm and support. When we launched the game last night (our time zone), we were amazed by the number of people playing Whisper Mountain Outbreak, and it’s been really fun watching our community and content creators enjoy the game, play together with their friends and communities.

We also appreciate all the feedback that you have given. It was very helpful for us in improving our game and knowing what will make your playing experience better.

[h3]The save system and more in the work![/h3]
We have read your feedback and noticed that one of the frequently mentioned concerns is the need for a proper save system. We apologize that this has affected the overall experience. We initially considered implementing a save system, and after reading the feedback, it gives us reassurance to work on it and integrate it into the game. 

Therefore, we are now actively working on the save system and other improvements to enhance the experience, and hope to have this feature as soon as possible. Other things we’re working on are [i]Quick Join and Meta Progression.[/i] Please look forward to it.

[i]If you have any more feedback, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us on Steam discussion, social media, community, or any other platforms where you can find us. [/i]

[b]Alternatively, you can send us an email or fill out the feedback form.[/b]
Email: wmo@togeproductions.com 
Feedback form: [url=https://forms.gle/9vA9KNNTZpKPYzK38]Whisper Mountain Outbreak Feedback Form[/url]

We apologize that you haven’t been able to experience the game to its full potential. We appreciate you giving us the chance to improve the game. And once again, thank you very much for your kind support! We are excited to deliver a co-op survival horror game that our community can enjoy.

[h3]10,000+ copies sold![/h3]
This is actually beyond our expectations. We didn’t expect that over 10,000 people would play Whisper Mountain Outbreak on day one. Thank you! This is a huge milestone for us, and we won’t be able to achieve it without your support.

notes.title: Whisper Mountain Outbreak Early Access Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/e893c436b51c4821652f22c83e46ad88eae0169b.png[/img]

[h3]The investigation starts now![/h3]
[i]Reporting in, agents.[/i]
 Gear up and prepare your best arsenal. Whisper Mountain Outbreak is now out to Early Access! The Bureau of Research and Investigation of Metaphysics (B.R.I.M.) is calling on all available agents to help contain the ongoing outbreak at Mount Bisik. 

[b][i]Be prepared to face new anomalies, explore more maps, and encounter tougher challenges![/i]
[/b]
[h3]Check out the Early Access Trailer![/h3]
[previewyoutube=J6t9SO7xeAE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Escape room meets survival horror![/h3]
Whisper Mountain Outbreak is a PvE co-op survival game set in a remote town haunted by ancient supernatural forces. As a secret government agent, explore cursed locations, solve challenging puzzles, and battle horrifying undead anomalies. 

[i]Choose your specialization, manage resources, and uncover the dark mystery beneath Mount Bisik. Will your team survive the outbreak... or be consumed by it?[/i]

[h3]Whisper Mountain Outbreak Now in Early Access![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1953230/Whisper_Mountain_Outbreak/
[h3]Recruit your friends to survive the outbreak! [/h3]
Can’t face the horrors of Mount Bisik alone? Do you need a helping hand to investigate further? Call upon your friends as reinforcement to join your lobby! With the recently announced Field Agent Friend’s Pass, anyone can join a lobby via the room code provided by the game owner.

[b][i]Play together with your friends or fellow agents in the community, and solve the mystery together! [/i][/b]

[h3]Play co-op for free with Friend’s Pass*[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2595010/Whisper_Mountain_Outbreak_Friends_Pass/
[i]*Get a copy of Whisper Mountain Outbreak, and recruit your friends to play online co-op for free![/i]

[h3]Learn more about Friend’s Pass here[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1953230/view/537734042335840030

[h3]We also have a special message from the developer![/h3]
[i]Hey everyone, Toge Kediri here![/i]

[b]Whisper Mountain Outbreak is finally out in Early Access![/b]
We just want to say a huge THANK YOU to everyone who’s been following us, wishlisting, and cheering us on all this time. Seeing your excitement has really made us believe in what we’re making and kept us confident that this game is worth building together with you.

This is still Early Access, so if you encounter anything unusual and aren’t sure whether it’s an actual bug or an in-game anomaly, please report it anyway, and our team will investigate immediately. You can send your findings to wmo@togeproductions.com. Every note you send really does help us make the game even better.

We hope you have an awesome time stopping Mount Bisik’s curse with your loved ones, your friends, or frenemies. It’s been such a wild ride getting here, and now we can finally share it with you. Can’t wait to hear what you think.

See you in the game!

[i]-Toge Productions, Kediri Divison — development team of Whisper Mountain Outbreak.[/i]

[h3]Join the Survivors Network![/h3]
If you're having a hard time finding a friend to play with, you can join Toge Productions Discord Community. Some of our community members are new and veteran agents from the limited-time demo who are always ready to help. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/707f2687b55c7dee24c5958afaf48dcdac0c3a45.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/1869edb15c91072eded00fa72e892272484d79ec.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/d03060f2c4b910a5184f4eaba68bdf08288f1715.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/886180fd9a2f2a3cc6280dc3080869bba818f37c.png"][/img]

We are also going to host an upcoming event for Friend’s Pass players who are looking for someone to team up with, don’t miss it!

If you have any questions, feedback, or suggestions, please don't hesitate to let us know on Discord. 
[i]We will continuously monitor and improve the game in Early Access. Stay updated with us! [/i]

Be prepared for the outbreak, agents.
Do keep in touch for a new mission briefing.

Stay sharp, and keep surviving! 🧟‍♂️💥
— B.R.I.M. Support Division

This week, we're taking a look at some changes we've made on the help our agents proceed with caution. From navigating the environment more smoothly, improving the player HUD, to streamlining lobby access-many of these adjustments were shaped by community feedback and internal playtesting. 

Kriswin, the supervising artist of Whisper Mountain Outbreak, will be answering a few questions about the changes made to the game. Refining the UI is an important step for us to create a better gameplay experience, whether you're a veteran agent or a rookie agent.

[h3]The importance of UI / UX for the players [/h3]
UI/UX plays a huge role in how players experience the game. A well-designed UI/UX will help players understand what’s going on. It helps you navigate into the game without confusion. In a tense survival horror game like Whisper Mountain Outbreak, where every second matters, having a clean and responsive interface makes a big difference.

We also wanted the interface to feel like something that supports the immersion rather than breaking it. That’s why we took the time to refine it, ensuring it feels intuitive, easy to read, and fitting the game’s horror vibe.

At first, I designed the UI with a military-inspired theme. Bold, solid visuals with a worn, metallic look to reflect strength and structure, which I felt suited the game's intense survival atmosphere. But as development went on, I realized that this approach had some drawbacks: the UI elements were too big and lacked transparency, which blocked important parts of the screen and made the gameplay feel cluttered and distracting.

So I shifted to a more minimalist UI, focusing on transparent zones, simple outlines, and silhouette icons to make the screen clearer and less cluttered. I also moved away from the military look and went for a mystery-investigator vibe that fits better with the game’s secret agency theme. Choosing a typewriter-style font helped add a subtle retro-horror feel that supports the tone we wanted.

With the new UI, the screen feels much more comfortable to look at. It doesn’t block key visual cues, and the overall mood is more immersive. Mystery and horror are now felt more strongly through the interface itself. I believe this change not only improved usability but also helped support the storytelling and tone of the game.

For me, the most important thing in creating UI/UX is clarity. Making sure players get the information they need without confusion, especially in the middle of intense gameplay. It has to be easy to read, quick to understand, and not get in the way of the action.

But beyond that, it also needs to support the game's tone and atmosphere. Since Whisper Mountain Outbreak is a survival horror game with a strong mystery element, the UI had to feel like part of that world, subtle, eerie, and immersive. notes.title: Developer Diary #1: Welcome to Whisper Mountain
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/10ffe35016328c62eb40c68ea8d65e492ec7ff41.png[/img]

[h3][i]Reporting in, Agents.[/i][/h3]

This is one of many entries where we will take a look at some behind the scenes content and interviews with the developers. You might learn some new insights on how to survive the outbreak. Expect a new diary entry every month, each featuring a variety of interesting discussions! 

For this month’s entry, Kashuur, the community manager at Toge Productions, having a chat with one of the crew members working on Whisper Mountain Outbreak — Kriswin Yuniar. From building the lore and shaping the atmosphere to designing characters and environments, Kriswin plays a huge role in bringing the game to life. 

[i]Grab a warm drink, equip your flashlight, and proceed with caution. Let’s venture together into the creative depths of Whisper Mountain Outbreak![/i]

[b]A close look at our latest key art. What evil forces lie beyond the fog?[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/4a233e881b75f527afd897912676714a2c23d0bf.png[/img]


💬[i]"Hi, Kriswin! So glad to have you with us today! I know for sure, a lot of people are curious to know more about you. So, we maybe should start from there first." [/i]

[h3]Who are you, and what do you do on this project?[/h3]
[b]Kriswin: [/b]"Hi, I’m Kriswin, the supervising artist at Toge Kediri—formerly known as Tahoe Games, before joining the Toge Productions family. I lead the visual direction for Whisper Mountain Outbreak, ensuring that everything, from character sprite designs to environment styles, aligns with the tone we’re aiming for.

Basically, everything you see on screen goes through my review before it’s approved by the game director. I also work closely with our narrative team to help shape the game’s lore and worldbuilding."

[h3]Footage from older iterations.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/3787efb6ba4f05158c18dfad916cb855dc57cfec.gif[/img]

[h3]Footage from recent iterations.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/8b63cc2ee8f66204061824ee72c4c6adbdc21ed4.gif[/img]

[h3]Enemies wearing different type of clothes.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/9c79e708ca4e16211d85d6a4b3ff0acfc7311525.png[/img]

[h3]Samples of character models and objects.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/0454f5589b0cef8641a27380df7e61e6ffa0c537.gif[/img]

💬[i]"I see... That’s kind of like saying you’re the secret boss behind the game, right? Just kidding! But that does bring up an interesting point. Since I know many people in the community are really hyped, let’s talk a bit about the game."[/i]

[h3]From your perspective, what is Whisper Mountain Outbreak?[/h3]
[b]Kriswin:[/b] "Whisper Mountain Outbreak is our love letter to fellow fans of classic survival horror, especially those who hold the Resident Evil Outbreak series close to their hearts. We recognize that RE Outbreak was a franchise ahead of its time. Even today, it still has a passionate fanbase that longs for its return from the grave.

As longtime fans ourselves, we felt compelled to create our take on what a modern Outbreak experience could be. Of course, we don’t intend to and could never hope to replace the original series. However, with this game, we aim to contribute to the growing library of co-op survival horror titles and offer a little something to ease the lingering nostalgia that many of us share."

[b]More footage from our latest update.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/0902d5f8378d0f9fc862cfa55bd06a17316f1c47.gif[/img]

💬[i]"Hey, I’m also a big fan of zombie games, you know? That’s why I’m super excited for Whisper Mountain Outbreak! But here’s the tricky part.. As a player myself, I’m always on the lookout for something new to play, and with so many zombie games coming out soon, it’s tough to choose. So..."[/i]

[h3]What makes Whisper Mountain Outbreak stand out from other zombie games?[/h3]
[b]Kriswin:[/b] "The first thing that stands out about Whisper Mountain Outbreak is definitely our visual direction. We combine 2D pixel-animated sprites with 3D environments, all presented through an isometric camera angle. While part of this choice was due to our technical limitations, it was also a deliberate decision to evoke a nostalgic retro vibe, while still feeling fresh and relevant in the era of modern game technology.

We wanted to stand out in a sea of games chasing hyper-realistic graphics. Instead, we focus on style, mood, and the core experience of teamwork and survival.

At its heart, Whisper Mountain Outbreak emphasizes cooperation: protecting each other, sharing resources, and solving puzzles together. The game is deliberately designed to be difficult to beat if players act selfishly. That said, we also give players full freedom in how they play each character. We believe this freedom creates room for unexpected, emergent gameplay moments that feel unique in every session.

In later iterations, we added meta roguelite elements to enhance replayability, encouraging players to try new strategies and playstyles each time they start over."

[b]Zombies will bother your investigation — clear them out before proceeding.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/31286c8784fa5d316c968935e9b5bd81effabf67.gif[/img]

💬[i]"You got me at the vibes. I played the demo before, and everything just felt right and tight. Now I’m really curious about the lore — when I played, I found some leftover notes from previous survivors and bits of info in the mission briefing..."[/i]

[h3]Where did the outbreak take place? And can you share any interesting details about how it all started?[/h3]
[b]Kriswin:[/b] "Whisper Mountain Outbreak is set in the fictional city of Daha in 1998. The name “Daha” is a nod to our hometown, Kediri. In ancient Java history, Kediri’s royal capital was known as Dahanapura. We took the name "Daha" from that historical root.

We chose Kediri as the inspiration for Whisper Mountain Outbreak’s setting because in real life, Kediri lies between Mount Wilis and Mount Kelud, while in the game, Daha is overshadowed by the mysterious Mount Bisik.

[b]A real-life shoot in Kediri, the developers' hometown.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/53f1f808be8ae8c8457bb9e440077b24b9f677d6.jpg[/img]

Instead of taking a sci-fi approach, we leaned into supernatural horror. The outbreak in Daha is caused by the growing influence of an ancient entity that has been unleashed from deep within the mountain. Its power brings about strange phenomena, causing the dead to rise again, driven by rage and bloodlust.

We drew inspiration from the Necronomicon lore in The Evil Dead series, particularly in Evil Dead Rise, where disturbing something ancient leads to terrifying consequences."

[b]Hence the gory environment you now see in the demo. [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/beea4b1addc4960a9417d72391e439eac570c6d1.gif[/img]

[b]A sample poster we made in Bahasa Indonesia, explaining how to avoid anomalies.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/260e74290d8d74fc8df65bb5130db867f49d1fa8.png[/img]


💬[i]"Oh my, that’s so cool! You guys actually used your hometown as a reference? It reminds me of how Mojiken based A Space for the Unbound on their hometown too! I’m really invested in the setting — it’s not your typical bio-zombie story. Since we’re talking about your hometown, I’d love to ask a bit more about you personally..."[/i]

[h3]Tell us a bit about the developers behind Whisper Mountain Outbreak! [/h3]
[b]Kriswin:[/b] "We’re a team of eight developers from Toge Kediri, with one additional member from Toge Productions HQ. Back when we were still known as Tahoe Games, we partnered with Toge to publish our game Rising Hell (2021). That collaboration eventually led to our acquisition by Toge in early 2022, after they took an interest in our roguelite portfolio, particularly Rising Hell.

[h3][i]An action roguelite where you need to rise up and fight through hell! [/i][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/657000/Rising_Hell/

When we were offered the Whisper Mountain Outbreak project, it was a big challenge for us. This is our first time working on an online multiplayer game, as well as our first 3D title. We’ve learned a great deal throughout the development process, and what you’ll be playing is the result of our team’s hard work. Something we’ve poured our hearts into and are truly proud to share."

[h3]A recent selfie from the developers at the studio in Kediri.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/03c06d4d01c941857a1e87fa9570ff800087ee81.jpg[/img]


💬[i]"Just that small number of devs making a game of this scale? You guys must’ve worked extra hard to achieve something like this. It’s absolutely amazing, and I can’t even begin to comprehend how you guys pulled it off! With the game just a month away from Early Access, everyone must be wondering how long you’ve been working on it."[/i]

[h3]When did the development of Whisper Mountain Outbreak begin and how is it going so far? [/h3]
[b]Kriswin:[/b] "Development for Whisper Mountain Outbreak began in early 2022. During the pre-production phase, we initially considered setting the story within the same universe as Toge’s Infectonator franchise. However, we eventually decided to separate the two, allowing us to create a darker, more serious tone for world-building.

In the early iterations, the game focused on a group of strangers forced to work together to survive while trying to escape a spreading curse in the city. But later, our game director proposed a new premise: the survivors are now anonymous recruits, brought in by the leader of a secret government agency to continue an investigation and find a way to stop the ancient entity’s influence from spreading beyond the city of Daha.

[b]Character artwork design for the agents.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/fdd65e2ce082c874a5a8963987e5811e23795ef9.jpg[/img]

We believe this shift gave the game a stronger direction. Players are now free to define their character. At the start of the game, they can choose a background class or job, each with unique skills. They can also fully customize their character’s appearance, as the design was intentionally kept identity-neutral to allow more immersion. This way, players can truly immerse themselves in their chosen role.

The secret-agency theme also ties in nicely with modern horror and new weird fiction, drawing inspiration from works like the FBC in the Alan Wake universe and the SCP Foundation."

[b]Logo of the Bureau of Research and Investigation of Metaphysics (B.R.I.M.)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/b868c70596078ff5c8b8f86f5c674d748859b18f.jpg[/img]


💬[i]"You guys definitely pulled this one off with the new changes. I see our community members are even more hooked with the current iteration! I wish you all the best of luck with the preparations leading up to the August release. Also, thank you so much for taking the time for this interview. And... "[/i]

[h3]Before we wrap up, is there anything you’d like to say to the community? [/h3]
[b]Kriswin:[/b] "We hope you enjoy our game! Grab your friends, siblings, partner, or even your spouse and play together. If you're looking for people to team up with, feel free to join our Discord. Who knows, you might make some new friends too.

While we all wait for an official remake (if it ever happens), there’s no harm in giving our game a shot!"

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1953230/Whisper_Mountain_Outbreak/ 
[i][b]Don't forget to wishlist us so that you can be informed of any upcoming updates![/b] [/i]

[i]Be prepared for the outbreak, agents! 
Do keep in touch for a new mission briefing.[/i]

[i]Stay sharp, and keep surviving! 🧟‍♂️💥
 — B.R.I.M. Support Division[/i]

notes.content:

[h3][i]Reporting in, Agents.[/i][/h3]
[b]A quick update on the limited-time demo, following the feedback we received over the past few days.[/b]

We’ve been listening to all your feedback, and this update focuses on fine-tuning the difficulty curve to provide a more balanced and enjoyable experience, especially for new players just starting out.

[h3]🔧What we have changed:[/h3]
[h3]🔸 Elite Enemy Types Removed from Early Levels[/h3]
[b]To help new players have a chance to learn and adapt on the field, we adjusted the gameplay so that elite enemies would no longer appear in the early stages. [/b]

[b]We’ve adjusted the total number of zombies to make each level feel more manageable without losing the thrill of survival. [/b]

[h3][i]Reporting in, Agents.[/i][/h3]
[b]The limited-time demo has been updated. B.R.I.M. agents now have more tools at their disposal to fend off the outbreak.[/b]

[h3]The B.R.I.M. Safehouse is restored, and now you are given more options on how you can operate.[/h3]
[b]The Bureau of Research and Investigation of Metaphysics (B.R.I.M.) must keep up to maintain control over the continuously evolving outbreak.[/b] More equipment and items have been authorized for use to aid your investigation. You can access them via the Safehouse, and you can collect resources on the field to unlock more upgrades.

[i]Be cautious as you progress in investigating Mount Bisik, where you will eventually encounter stronger anomalies in the field. [/i]

[b]Here is the list of updates that you can check out from the new updated demo. [/b]

[h3]🛠️ Crafting System[/h3]
[b]Craft supplies, equipment, and weapons to help your investigation.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/9bb9a5afa43a5b3c663bbf43557f8bcd7636c79e.png[/img]
The Workbench is now available, enabling agents to access a range of tools to support their investigations. You'll need different materials to craft the appropriate items, which can be obtained in the field and after completing missions.

[h3]⚡ Upgrade Skill[/h3]
[b]Learn new skills, and upgrade your Agent to be more proficient on the field. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/81df88018a256d60a1b6580ae06431e23431c159.png[/img]

The Workbench also offers various options for agents to learn new skills. Boost physical stats, perform more actions, or unlock additional crafting options by upgrading the appropriate skills. You can earn more skill points by completing missions in the field.

[h3]🧑‍✈️ Character’s Specialization[/h3]
[b]Now, you can choose your specialization at the start of the game.  [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/2b2b266db77a0de5221205898acea746eb485369.png[/img]

Every B.R.I.M. Agent has a background on how they come in contact with the Bureau. There are several specializations given at random. Be sure to choose one that fits your playstyle. Whether you play solo or as a team, different specializations do matter in increasing your chances of survival. 

[h3]🔫 Upgrade Ranged Weapons[/h3]
[b]Ranged combat is your lifeline against the horde, attach your gun to shape your playstyle. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/7f1f27dba8b0b96aab7dbf932ec3e3f0232967a6.png[/img]

Ranged weapon attachments are available, allowing you to create custom combinations. Mix and match components like high-caliber barrels, tactical scopes, and magazine extensions to suit your needs and enhance your weapon's power. You can access them by crafting them on the Workbench and unlocking a specific skill.

[h3]🗺️ Level Selection[/h3]
[b]All intel we had gathered are presented here. You have the freedom to proceed with your investigation as you see fit. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/dc6e0b844f021cf31e9620fadee2e07ab3dfe1ac.png[/img]

The level selection screen serves as the mission briefing for each new level as you progress through the game. Here, you can review your main objectives with your team and gain important field information, as well as learn about the equipment you may encounter in the specified area. 

[h3]🧥 Character Customization (Wardrobe)[/h3]
[b]Define yourself, and fight off the horde with style. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/33645538b3b3e1d72f01c58a667b16ee8871cfba.gif[/img]

The Wardrobe is now accessible to all Agents in the Safehouse. Customize your character with a variety of pre-made heads and bodies. Outfit colors are also interchangeable. You can change your look before or after each mission.

[h3]🪖 Onboarding NPC[/h3]
[b]Meet B.R.I.M. Captain Atma, the one who helped you before everything went wrong.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/a777964d46c311a8ccf7f51979d84e5ffb227bf8.gif[/img]

Before entering the Safehouse, you will first report to a Special Agent assigned to assist with the Mount Bisik investigation. He had contacted many agents who had failed on the field, and his intel is valuable for us before proceeding on each mission. 

[h3]🔁 Game Loop (Your Chances to Retry)[/h3]
[b]The horror is unrelenting. You have three chances to fight back.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/7063dba8d138b1de0a912285d38fa6abbea23388.png[/img]

Each new game grants you three chances to try again after failing a mission. Each failure returns you to the Safehouse—but without the supplies and equipment you brought. With every setback, one of your three lanterns shatters, and your chances of survival grow ever slimmer. You can always use the Item Box to store your items in case you fail on the field. 

[h3]👹 New Elite Enemy: Hollow Mother[/h3]
[b]A new type of anomaly has been discovered. Proceed with caution.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/d8dcf60b1d3f675452785102822bd457d32daadb.gif[/img]

A new elite enemy has been added to the demo, appearing in one of the missions. Once a grieving mother, now a bloated husk twisted by cursed fog. Her rotting flesh oozes decay through pulsing holes. Slow but tough, she soaks up heavy damage—until death, when she explodes in a deadly burst of bile and bone. Be prepared and enjoy the thrill of facing against the Hollow Mother.


[h3]ːsteamthisː Quality of Life Updates[/h3]
[h3] ːsstpistolː Training Area[/h3]
[b]Train and learn all the basics before entering the field.[/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/aa53166591e95915d81a2abf33ede4b4f243d9a3.gif[/img]

New players can now learn from a new, updated B.R.I.M. manual before starting their investigations. You’ll complete several training sessions, such as movement, melee attacks, shooting, and more advanced mechanics. These exercises will help new agents get started with ease.

[h3]🔊 Proximity Voice Chat[/h3]
[b]Working together by communicating in the field will increase your chances of survival. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/56f115115e5683f9dfa394a4f94e082095a729c2.gif[/img]

You can now use local voice chat to communicate with other agents. Additionally, there is equipment to help you stay in touch when you’re far apart when covering larger investigation areas.

[h3]✉️ Invite Friends (Steam)[/h3]
[b]Play the demo for free and invite your friends to play together as a team! [/b]
You can now invite your friends on Steam to play with. Team up for a game session and enjoy a more exciting experience together

[h3]🎮 Updated & Improved User Interface[/h3]
[b]The UI is now more streamlined, making it easier for players to navigate the game.[/b]
After gathering feedback and conducting extensive testing, we implemented a new user interface (UI) to provide a more enjoyable experience for all players.

notes.title: The Horror Continues Until 11 November and Removing the Bugs Out
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495880/b510806a8026c91a7dbd9c5ec958f4f5e0ef944d.png[/img]

[h3][i]Welcome, survivors.[/i][/h3]
[b]We've just cleaned the bugs out, and you can still play the demo until 11 November! [/b]

Haven't got the chance to fully enjoy what the demo had to offer last week? We had received your feedback and had improved the demo much further. You can still play the demo solo or together with your friends. We continuously strive to enhance the game based on everyone's feedback, aiming for a better player experience.

Now in the demo, you can choose the region according to your nearest location. But, if you plan to play together with someone from a different region, the party needs to choose a region based on the host server to play together. 

Additional Feature Updates: 
1. Functional controls using the Steam Deck. 
2. Functional using the gamepad controls. 

Bug Fixes: 
1. Fix the stuck while several players are reviving a teammate.
2. Fix the volume of music and ambient getting lower when the horde appears
3. Fix the issue when a player disconnected from a co-op game, the game can’t be finished. 
4. Fix the info bubble of the “Dying” state still appearing even after the player has revived.
5. Fix the stamina issue when the player is not sprinting. 
6. Fix the ammo duplication issue. 
7. Fix where the player gets stuck when attacking or shooting. 
8. Fix where the player gets out of the map building when pushed by enemies. 
9. Fix when the reload ammo is not depleting. 
10. Fix changing regions that are sometimes still connected to the Singapore region. 
11. Fix the player can still aim while sprinting. 
12. Fix the player is not pursued by zombies in certain spots. 
13. Fix the player can still move while opening inventory.
14. Fix the camera and the zombie sprite not rotating accordingly. The issue while the zombie gets attacked and the camera rotates simultaneously. 
15. Fix the item placement where it can’t be picked in the same area as the puzzles. 
16. Fix the grenade count in the inventory, appearing as minus count. 
17. Fix the enemies getting stuck.
